name: std-notification-center
description: std-notification-center — per-user notification preferences, web-push subscriptions, and the digest drain for suppressed notifications. Owns the two owner-scoped stores std-notify-on-event consults at dispatch time: NotificationPreference rows (per event key: mode instant/digest/off, channel override, per-user quiet hours) and PushSubscription rows (captured via the browser/push-subscribe flow — the shared service worker + PushManager subscription, persisted as flat endpoint/p256dh/auth credentials). The DigestDrain trait is the delivery half of every suppression std-notify-on-event records: an hourly cron tick scans NotificationRecord audit rows left undispatched for digest/quiet-hours reasons and at least `minAgeHours` old, delivers each by email (the digest channel), and marks it dispatched — the reminder-scheduler self-driving scan loop verbatim. Compose alongside std-notify-on-event: the listener suppresses and records, this atom captures subscriptions, edits preferences, and drains.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Owner of this preference row — rows are meant to be private to their owner. Access predicates need an [identity] roster, so the binding organism (which declares one) owns the @read/@update scoping; the generic atom cannot.

fields.name: eventType
fields.description: Event key this preference applies to (matches a listener's eventKey); blank = all events.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Delivery mode: instant (default), digest (deferred to the drain cycle), or off (muted).
fields.synonyms: delivery mode, frequency, cadence, mute, defer

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Channel override for this user (in-app/email/sms/push/webhook); blank = the listener's configured channel.

fields.name: quietStartHour
fields.description: Per-user quiet-hours start (hour 0-23); equal to quietEndHour = disabled.
fields.synonyms: quiet start, do not disturb from

fields.name: quietEndHour
fields.description: Per-user quiet-hours end (hour 0-23); equal to quietStartHour = disabled.
fields.synonyms: quiet end, do not disturb until

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Owner of this browser push subscription. Owner-scoped access predicates belong to the binding organism's [identity] roster, as with NotificationPreference.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Push service endpoint URL for this subscription.

fields.name: p256dh
fields.description: Client public key (p256dh) of the subscription.

fields.name: auth
fields.description: Auth secret of the subscription.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When this subscription was captured.

fields.name: lastError
fields.description: Scratch: last subscribe-flow failure shown to the user; blank = none.

fields.name: recipient
fields.description: The identifier of the entity receiving the notification.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: The delivery method for the notification (e.g., email, SMS, in-app).

fields.name: message
fields.description: The content of the notification message.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Indicates the importance or urgency level of the notification.

fields.name: dispatched
fields.description: Indicates whether the notification has been successfully sent.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Suppression reason or delivery failure detail when dispatched is false.
fields.synonyms: error message, failure reason, dispatch error

fields.name: recordedAt
fields.description: Timestamp indicating when the notification record was created.

fields.name: headId
fields.description: Scratch: id of the audit row the drain loop is currently delivering.

fields.name: headRecipient
fields.description: Scratch: recipient of the row being delivered.

fields.name: headMessage
fields.description: Scratch: message of the row being delivered.

fields.name: drainedCount
fields.description: Number of rows delivered in the current drain cycle.

fields.name: lastError
fields.description: Last drain failure; blank = none.

digestSubject.label: Digest email subject
digestSubject.description: Subject line for drained digest deliveries.
digestSubject.synonyms: digest title, summary subject, email subject

minAgeHours.label: Minimum age (hours)
minAgeHours.description: Only drain audit rows at least this many hours old, so quiet-hours suppressions are not redelivered inside their window.
minAgeHours.synonyms: delay, drain delay, hold for, batch window

digestEnabled.label: Deliver digests
digestEnabled.description: Drain suppressed notifications (digest-deferred and quiet-hours audit rows) on the hourly cycle. Off by default.
digestEnabled.synonyms: enable digest, digest mode, batch notifications, daily summary, drain suppressed
